title: React v2 foundation: Zustand store, typed API client, React Router v6, and actor/tenant header injection
goal: The ui-v2 directory contains a Vite + React 18 + TypeScript + Tailwind shell with 3 components (App.tsx, Intake.tsx, CinemaMode.tsx). Before any screen can be built with real data, three foundational layers are required. (1) ZUSTAND STORE — install zustand and create src/store/index.ts with the following slices: engagements (list, selectedId), runs (list for selected engagement, selectedRunId, selectedRun), tasks (for selected run), findings (for selected run), inventory (snapshot for selected run), actor (name: string, role: string), settings (chatgpt_connected: bool, tool_readiness: object), runStream (status: 'connected'|'disconnected', runId: string|null). Each slice has set/get actions. Use Zustand devtools in development. (2) API CLIENT — create src/api/client.ts that exports a typed fetch wrapper: api(path: string, options?). The function reads actor name from Zustand store and injects X-Actor header on every request. Base URL is import.meta.env.VITE_API_BASE_URL defaulting to 'http://127.0.0.1:8000'. Create typed response interfaces in src/api/types.ts mirroring the FastAPI schemas for: Engagement, Run, Task, TaskExecution, Finding, InventorySnapshot, RunProfile, AgentProposal, AssessmentChain. Create named API functions: getEngagements(), getRunsForEngagement(id), getRun(id), getRunTasks(id), getRunFindings(id), getRunInventory(id), getRunAiInsights(id), getSettings(), postEngagement(data), postRun(engagementId, data), patchConfirmAuthorization(engagementId), postScope(engagementId, data), postInventoryRun(data), cancelRun(id). (3) REACT ROUTER v6 — install react-router-dom. Create routes: / → Dashboard, /intake → Intake, /mission-control → MissionControl, /findings → FindingsTheater, /reports → ReportCenter, /settings → Settings, /history → History, /problems → ProblemsCenter, /packs → Packs, /research → Research. The App.tsx sidebar NavItems use <Link> instead of onClick setState. (4) ENGAGEMENT BOOTSTRAP — on app load, call getEngagements() and hydrate the store. Auto-select the most recent engagement. Watch selectedEngagementId and reload runs when it changes. (5) VITE PROXY — configure vite.config.ts to proxy /api/* to http://127.0.0.1:8000 in development so CORS is not an issue.
scope: ui-v2 currently has no state management, no API integration, and no routing. Every screen would be a dead end without this foundation. Must be the first task completed before any other ui-v2 task.
generation_reason: React v2 foundation layer required before any screen can show real data.
